component.name: Plezy
component.summary: Watch and listen to your Plex, Jellyfin and Emby libraries

description.p: This is a community package of Plezy, maintained independently. It repackages the official upstream build unmodified.
Plezy is a media client for Plex, Jellyfin and Emby servers. Browse your libraries, stream video and music, and download media for offline playback.
Playback uses MPV with support for subtitles, multiple audio tracks, playback speed controls, and hardware video decoding on supported systems.

The package follows the permissions of upstream's own Flatpak build: network access to reach your servers, audio, device access for GPU decoding and game controllers, media controls over MPRIS, and the Discord sockets for the optional rich presence integration. It has no access to your home directory; files are opened and saved through the file chooser portal, and downloads and settings stay in the application's private per-app directory.
